note: On the east shore of 640-acre Day Lake, a mile north of Clam Lake on County GG, with shaded sites under tall pines, a swimming beach, a fishing pier and a short interpretive trail. Six paved barrier-free sites connect to the pier by paved paths. ATVs/UTVs may ride from the campground to the Dead Horse Run trail. Parking aprons are grass and dirt except on the paved Paper Birch loop. The boat launch is 2 mi south on County M. --Claude
summary: FS page, recreation.gov facility record and per-site catalog read. 52 sites (13 in Blueberry/Heron closed for now; 3 walk-in), no hookups, vault toilets and a hand pump, no dump. 25 reservable on recreation.gov (4-day cutoff), the rest first-come; $18 confirmed. Lakeview kept (weak): the nearest sites are 60-100 m from shore under continuous pines. Pin ~720 m south of the site loops; re-pin proposed. Designated off-road vehicle campground: OHV flag for the reviewer.
flags: OHV (flag, not a drop): recreation.gov calls it 'a designated off-road vehicle campground, allowing off-road vehicle use to and from the nearby trails', and the FS page says 'The Dead Horse ATV trail can be accessed directly from the Day Lake Recreation Area'. It is primarily a general family lakeside campground (beach, fishing pier, interpretive trail). I read it as a general campground with an OHV side, so it stays.

WATERFRONT: lakeview kept, weak (no --AWH). On Esri imagery the 38 catalog sites all sit under continuous pine canopy. The closest are PAPE 021/022 (46.1820,-90.9065 / 46.1819,-90.9068), REDP 036 (46.1833,-90.9041) and MUSK 048/049 (46.1852,-90.9018 / 46.1850,-90.9019), each about 60-100 m from the waterline through unbroken trees. No site is within about 50 m over open ground. If anything it could go down to not waterfront (the canopy may hide the lake from every site); the FS 'on the east shore' wording supports a view at most.

PIN: 46.1765,-90.9091 -> 46.1824,-90.9053 (centroid of the 38 recreation.gov site coordinates), about 720 m. The stored point is recreation.gov's facility point south of the loops near County GG; the nearest site (010) is about 400 m north of it.
SEASON (manual, not overwritten): FS 'May 1- October 15' matches the stored value. Note that recreation.gov's rate table sells first-come nights through 10-31 in 2027 (FCFS 10-12..10-31).

SITES: 52 confirmed. The 13 closed sites are those missing from the recreation.gov catalog (011-017 and 040-045). Catalog lengths run 25-60 ft (site 009 is 60 ft), so max_rig_ft 45 follows the FS page.
PHONE: 715-264-2511 (Great Divide RD, Glidden) is still listed by recreation.gov; the FS page's contact is the Hayward Office, 715-638-7243. Optional: 715-264-2511 -> 715-638-7243.
WEBSITE: both stored links work (200). Fine.
FEES: $18 confirmed ($9 with Senior/Access pass); the group site 023 is $36.
